Consolidated Usability Report

Source: R/usability_report.R
usability_report.Rd

Runs every usability check the package provides over one metadata frame in a single call and assembles the results into one coherent report. It is a pure orchestration and aggregation layer: it invents no new pass/warn/fail criteria, thresholds, or scores. The scored indicators keep their own U-001..U-004 semantics and weighted roll-up (from usability_summary()), and the advisory diagnostics keep their descriptive, unscored finding counts.

Usage

usability_report(
  metadata,
  assets = character(0),
  ctx,
  config = NULL,
  diagnostics = TRUE
)

Arguments

metadata

A data frame with columns dataset, variable, label, origin, derivation (optional), and codelist (optional). May span several datasets (one row per variable per dataset). Compatible with the adam_metadata, sdtm_metadata, and oncology_metadata datasets from r4subdata.

assets

A character vector of asset names present in the submission package, passed to assess_reviewer_guide(). Defaults to character(0).

ctx

A run context created by r4subcore::r4sub_run_context().

config

A configuration list from usability_config_default(). If NULL the default configuration is used.

diagnostics

Logical; when TRUE (the default) the advisory diagnostics are run and aggregated alongside the scored indicators. When FALSE only the scored indicators are reported.

Value

A usability_report object (a list with class "usability_report") with:

study_id

The study identifier from the evidence.

n_datasets

Number of distinct datasets in metadata.

n_vars

Number of variable-level locations assessed (as counted by usability_summary()).

overall_score

The weighted scored-indicator score from usability_summary(); NA when nothing is applicable.

n_fail,n_warn

Total fail and warn rows across the scored indicators.

n_findings

Total number of advisory diagnostic findings.

checks

A tidy per-check summary tibble: one row per check with check, check_name, check_type ("scored" or "diagnostic"), n_items, n_pass, n_warn, n_fail, n_na, n_findings, and pct_pass. Scored-only columns are NA for diagnostics.

findings

A combined tidy tibble of the offending items across all checks, with columns check, check_type, finding_type, dataset, variable, and detail.

evidence

The combined R4SUB evidence tibble from the scored indicators (see r4subcore::as_evidence()).

scored

The usability_summary() result for the scored indicators.

config

The configuration used.

Details

Two families of check are combined:

Scored indicators

assess_label_quality() (U-001), assess_define_completeness() (U-002), assess_annotation_coverage() (U-003), and assess_reviewer_guide() (U-004), run together through usability_indicators(). These emit validated R4SUB evidence and carry pass/warn/fail/na results and a weighted overall score.

Advisory diagnostics

label_consistency(), variable_name_conformance() (run over the distinct variable names), and variable_attribute_consistency(). These are descriptive: they report a tidy set of findings and are never scored or rolled into the overall score.

The overall usability score is exactly the weighted score from usability_summary() over the four scored indicators; the diagnostics contribute only finding counts, never a pass/fail judgement.

See also

usability_indicators() and usability_summary() for the scored indicators; label_consistency(), variable_name_conformance(), and variable_attribute_consistency() for the advisory diagnostics.

Examples

ctx <- suppressMessages(r4subcore::r4sub_run_context(study_id = "STUDY01"))
rep <- suppressMessages(usability_report(
  r4subdata::oncology_metadata,
  assets = c("ADRG", "define.xml"),
  ctx = ctx
))
rep$checks
#> # A tibble: 7 × 10
#>   check      check_name check_type n_items n_pass n_warn n_fail  n_na n_findings
#>   <chr>      <chr>      <chr>        <int>  <int>  <int>  <int> <int>      <int>
#> 1 U-001      Variable … scored          32     32      0      0     0          0
#> 2 U-002      Define-XM… scored          32     29      0      3     0          3
#> 3 U-003      Annotatio… scored           3      2      0      1     0          1
#> 4 U-004      Reviewer … scored           1      1      0      0     0          0
#> 5 label_con… Label Con… diagnostic      NA     NA     NA     NA    NA          0
#> 6 variable_… Variable … diagnostic      NA     NA     NA     NA    NA          0
#> 7 variable_… Variable … diagnostic      NA     NA     NA     NA    NA          0
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: pct_pass <dbl>
print(rep)
#> 
#> ── R4SUB Usability Report ──
#> 
#> Study: "STUDY01" | Datasets: 3 | Variables assessed: 32
#> 
#> Scored indicators
#> ✓ Variable Label Quality: 100% pass (32/32)
#> ✓ Define-XML Completeness: 90.6% pass (29/32)
#> ✗ Annotation Coverage: 66.7% pass (2/3)
#> ✓ Reviewer Guide Presence: 100% pass (1/1)
#> 
#> Advisory diagnostics (descriptive, unscored)
#> ✓ Label Consistency: no findings
#> ✓ Variable Name Conformance: no findings
#> ✓ Variable Attribute Consistency: no findings
#> 
#> ℹ Overall usability score: 88.4%
